mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND DATE(r.r_created) = CURDATE() ) AS today_cnt,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') ) AS month_cnt,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.r_total_price), 0) FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND r.r_status != 'CANCELLED' ) AS month_revenue,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status = 'CANCELLED' AND DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') ) AS cancel_cnt

SELECT r.r_idx AS res_idx, CONCAT('RES-', LPAD(r.r_idx, 6, '0')) AS res_code, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_start_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_end_time, r.r_headcount AS res_headcount, r.r_total_price AS res_total_price, r.r_content AS res_content, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_created, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_updated, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS res_updated, r.r_status AS res_status, u.u_idx AS user_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, u.u_phone AS user_phone, u.u_email AS user_email, s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.s_name AS spc_name, s.s_type AS spc_type, s.s_price AS spc_price, b.b_idx AS brn_idx, b.b_name AS brn_name, v.v_idx AS rev_idx, v.v_rating AS rev_rating, v.v_content AS rev_content, DATE_FORMAT(v.v_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rev_created_at FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx JOIN user u ON r.u_idx = u.u_idx LEFT JOIN review v ON v.v_idx = ( SELECT v2.v_idx FROM review v2 WHERE v2.u_idx = r.u_idx AND v2.s_idx = r.s_idx AND v2.v_parent_idx = 0 ORDER BY v2.v_created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE r.r_idx = #{resIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx}
SELECT s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.s_name AS spc_name FROM space s JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} ORDER BY b.b_name, s.s_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS event_date, s.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.s_name AS spc_name, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND YEAR(r.r_start_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(r.r_start_time) = #{month} GROUP BY DATE(r.r_start_time), s.s_idx, s.s_name ORDER BY event_date, s.s_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.r_total_price) AS revenue FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND r.r_created >= #{startDate}
AND r.r_created < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY period_label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%x-%v주') AS period_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.r_total_price) AS revenue FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND r.r_created >= #{startDate}
AND r.r_created < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%x%v') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%x%v')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m') AS period_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.r_total_price) AS revenue FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND r.r_created >= #{startDate}
AND r.r_created < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.r_created, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period_label

SELECT s.s_name AS spc_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.r_total_price) AS revenue, s.s_type AS spc_type FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND r.r_created >= #{startDate}
AND r.r_created < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY s.s_idx, s.s_name, s.s_type ORDER BY revenue DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx SET r.r_status = 'CONFIRMED', r.r_updated = NOW() WHERE r.r_idx = #{resIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx SET r.r_status = 'CANCELLED', r.r_content = #{reason}, r.r_updated = NOW() WHERE r.r_idx = #{resIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND r.r_status = 'PENDING'
